title: Storage providers
description: Where backups can be sent. A folder on this server is quick, but it goes with the server if the server is lost, so keep important copies elsewhere too.
notConnectedHint: Not offered to backups until it is connected.

delete.title: Delete this destination?
delete.description: Backups set to send files to {{name}} stop running until you pick another one. Files already stored there stay where they are.

disconnect.title: Disconnect this destination?
disconnect.description: The panel gives up its access to {{name}}. Backups stop using it until it is connected again, and its files stay where they are.

oauth.editHint: Only the name can be changed here. To use another account, disconnect and connect again.

errors.missing_state: The answer from the provider was incomplete. Try connecting again.
errors.invalid_state: That attempt has expired. Try connecting again.
errors.exchange_failed: The provider did not accept this sign-in. Try connecting again.

description.local: A folder the panel writes to on this server.
description.server: The connection is tried before it is saved.
description.s3: The connection is tried before it is saved. The key needs to list, read, write and delete files in this bucket.
description.oauth: Use your own app's credentials, registered with the provider. You are sent there to grant access right after saving.

fields.name: Name
fields.hostKeyHint: The key this server identified itself with.
fields.clientSecretHint: From your own OAuth app. Kept sealed.
fields.usernameHint: The account to sign in with.
fields.nameHint: How it appears in the list of destinations.

hints.path: An absolute path on this server, used for nothing but backups.
hints.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current one.
hints.rootPath: Where on the server everything is kept. Empty means where the login starts.
hints.tls: Plain FTP sends the password unencrypted.
hints.trustNewHostKey: The server presented a different key from the one on record. Turn this on only if you know why it changed.
hints.endpointOptional: Leave empty to use the provider's usual address.
hints.storageClass: Common values: {{classes}}. Leave empty for the bucket's default.
hints.prefix: A folder inside the bucket that all files go under.

redirectUrl.dropbox: Register this exact address in your Dropbox app's settings.
redirectUrl.google-drive: Register this exact address in your Google Cloud OAuth client.

errors.name: Give it a name
errors.path: Use an absolute path with no . or .. in it
errors.host: Enter a hostname or IP address
errors.rootPath: Use a folder path with no . or .. in it
errors.endpoint: Enter a full URL with no path
errors.prefix: Use a folder path with no . or .. in it

permissions.title: Permissions needed
permissions.hint: The panel tries these when you save: it lists, writes, reads back and deletes a small file.
